item.title: NHL Stanley Cup Final 2026: Here’s How to Watch Vegas Golden Knights vs. Carolina Hurricanes Live Online
item.description:
[Energetic music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the podcast, hockey fans. The 2026 NHL Playoffs are wrapping up, and the Stanley Cup Final is just around the corner. The Vegas Golden Knights and Carolina Hurricanes are set to face off for the iconic trophy, and we've got all the details on how to catch the action live."
[Short sound effect]
Host: "The series starts on June 2nd, with all games airing on ABC and streaming live on ESPN Unlimited at 8 p.m. ET/5 p.m. PT. But don't worry if you don't have cable – there are plenty of streaming options available."
[Quick music transition]
Host: "You can watch ABC without cable using services like DirecTV, Sling TV, and more. DirecTV offers a free 5-day trial, and their 'Entertainment' package starts at $59.99 per month. Sling TV's Blue package includes ABC and over 40 channels for $45.99 per month, with a free cloud DVR and additional channels."
[Short sound effect]
Host: "If you're looking for a streaming bundle, consider Hulu + Live TV, which includes access to over 95 live TV channels, including ESPN and NBC, plus the Hulu library. Or, you can sign up for ESPN Unlimited, the official streaming platform for ESPN, for $29.99 per month."
[Music transitions to a wrap-up theme]
Host: "So, there you have it – all the ways to watch the 2026 NHL Stanley Cup Final online. Don't miss the puck drop on June 2nd, and enjoy the games with your favorite streaming service. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next podcast."
[Music and sound effects fade out]
